This is the first application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of regular bail relating to FIR No.182/2023 registered at Police Station-Sihora District-Jabalpur (MP) for the offence under Sections 376, 376(2)(n), 376(3), 506, 450, 34 of IPC &
Section 5/6, 3/4 of POCSO Act & Section 66(E) of Information Technology Act.
2 . entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Applicant is not the main accused.
Investigation in the case is complete and charge-sheet has been filed.
In these circumstances, applicant may be enlarged on bail.
3 . Learned Government Advocate appearing for the State as well as counsel appearing for Objector opposed the application for grant of bail.

It is submitted that applicant was present along with main accused person, when incident took place and he was taking photographs of the incident and had sent photographs to sister of prosecutrix and forced her to have physical relationship with him.
It is submitted that applicant is equally responsible for rape as Section 34 of IPC is also registered against applicant.
In these circumstances, application for grant of bail may be dismissed.
4. Heard the counsel for the parties.
5. Applicant was present on spot.
He did not intervene and took photographs.
Later tried to blackmail sister of prosecutrix.
Those persons, who were present on spot and were aiding in offence are also liable for same punishment as of rape.
6. Considering the same, bail application filed by applicant is dismissed.
